kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتكف (form VIII)
# نَعْتَكِفُ (naʕtakifu) /naʕ.ta.ki.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# نَعْتَكِفَ (naʕtakifa) /naʕ.ta.ki.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# نَعْتَكِفْ (naʕtakif) /naʕ.ta.kif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
